anti_overlap: Focuses on species generation coherence — not terrain migration (fd-terrain-migration), beauty computation (fd-observer-beauty), entity density (fd-ecs-flora-entity-budget), or garden scope (fd-garden-art-sprint-scope)
decision_lens: Does the species generation produce learnable, distinct species or noisy parameter soup? Do the generation axes interact coherently with the geology substrate?
focus: Procedural species generation: learnability vs. diversity, axis cross-product coherence, soil-type coupling
name: fd-botanical-procgen-species-coherence
persona: Procedural content generation specialist with deep experience in species simulation and biological taxonomy systems in games
review_areas: Q1 species count: cognitive load at each option (8-12 vs. 20-30 vs. fixed vs. layered) — which produces recognizable species?

Axis cross-product coherence: do the 8 generation axes (growth form, leaf type, seasonal behavior, soil preference, beauty, growth rate, spread, wood quality) produce meaningful combinations or nonsensical chimeras?
Soil-type coupling to geology TileData: species soil_preference axis must map to SoilKind enum values (Loam, Clay, Sand, Peat, Rocky) — are there orphan preferences?
Name generation: composable 3-part names from pools — does the pool size support the species count without repetitive names?
Ancient species: civilization aesthetic_imprint on growth pattern — does this interact with the standard generation axes or create a parallel system?

severity_examples.condition: No constraint system on axis cross-products
severity_examples.scenario: Species generation axes produce incoherent combinations (aquatic + rocky-soil + needle-leaf)

severity_examples.condition: Axes correlate too strongly, collapsing diversity
severity_examples.scenario: 20+ species generated but only 3 visually distinct categories emerge from axis combinations

severity_examples.condition: Decoupled enum definitions between flora and geology
severity_examples.scenario: Species soil preferences reference soil types not in the geology system

success_hints: Check whether species feel like species (distinct identity, recognizable) or like database rows (parameter variations). The test: could a player describe a species to another player?
task_context: Flora design for Elf Revel — Rust ECS elven colony sim with geology foundation (TileData, SoilKind, fertility, erosion)
